name: inspect_image
description: Ask a vision model about one image. The model assigned to Vision in Media models answers; without an assignment the conversation model does. Supply a worktree-relative path or an attachment ID from this conversation and a question in prompt. Do not replay an uncertain request.

path.description: Select exactly one image source: path or attachment, never both.

attachment.description: Select exactly one image source: attachment or path, never both.

name: generate_image
description: Generate or edit real images under assets/generated without replacing existing files. Describe the subject, purpose, style, composition and constraints in prompt; pass references (worktree-relative image paths or conversation attachment IDs) to edit existing images. Omit channel and model to use the active default backend, or specify channel, model, size, quality, count, or file_name when requested. Do not substitute SVG or replay an uncertain generation.

prompt.description: Visual description for generation or editing instructions.

file_name.description: Optional plain output file name without path separators (for example sunset.png). When count > 1, -1/-2 suffixes are appended.

channel.description: Optional image backend override. Defaults to auto.

model.description: Optional image model ID override for the selected channel.

size.description: Optional output dimensions such as 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536, 2048x2048, or auto.

quality.description: Optional quality level. Automatically ignored by models that do not support quality.

count.description: Number of images to generate (1-4, default 1).

references.description: Optional worktree-relative image paths or conversation attachment IDs to edit via /v1/images/edits.

name: generate_video
description: Generate a video with the model assigned to Video in Media models; without an assignment the conversation model generates it. Save under assets/generated without replacing existing files. file_name is an optional plain name ending in .mp4. Stopping local work does not cancel a job already accepted by the provider. When a result names a job that was accepted but not saved, call again with that job and the same prompt to fetch it; never submit the prompt again without it.

job.description: Job named by an earlier result; fetches that video instead of generating a new one
